name: Surrealism
what_it_means: Surrealist design borrows from Magritte and Dalí: impossible scenes, floating objects, doors in the sky, giant eyes, melting forms and dramatic shadows. It makes a brand feel imaginative and memorable by bending reality while keeping the UI itself simple.
signature_moves: Impossible compositions: floating, oversized objects → Arches, doors, stairs leading nowhere
Dreamy skies and long cast shadows
Clean serif/sans type placed calmly on top
best_for: Art & culture, creative agencies, fragrances, music, storytelling
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a homepage for [CREATIVE BRAND] in a Surrealist style inspired by Magritte. A calm sky-blue gradient (#9EC9F0) above a sandy plane (#F4D9B8) with a perspective checkerboard floor fading into the distance. Place impossible objects: a free-standing doorway opening onto a night sky, a giant floating sphere with a long cast shadow, a staircase that ends in the air, and a cloud passing through an arch. Headline in an elegant serif (DM Serif Display, 64px) in deep navy (#2D3A6B). Keep UI minimal; objects drift slowly on scroll (parallax).
